text:
12. 4. 3

Daṇḍasuttaṃ

3875. Seyyathāpi bhikkhave, daṇḍo upari vehesaṃ khitto sakimpi mulena nipatati, sakimpi majjhena nipatati, sakimpi aggena nipatati. Evameva kho bhikkhave, avijjānīvaraṇā sattā taṇhāsaṃyojanā sandhāvannā sakimpi asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchanti, sakimpi parasmā lokā imaṃ lokaṃ āgacchanti. Taṃ kissa hetu? Adiṭṭhattā bhikkhave, catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ. Katamesaṃ catunnaṃ: dukkhassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhasamudayassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhanirodhassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa. tasmātiha bhikkhave, "idaṃ dukkhanti" yogo karaṇīyo, "ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti" yogo karaṇīyo, "ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti" yogo karaṇīyo, "ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti" yogo karaṇīyoti.
